paraphrase: Ēkānta Rāmayya, challenged by the Jainas of Abalūr, wagers his head on Śiva's supremacy, cuts it off before Śiva and receives it back whole; the Jainas yield and their shrine is given to Śiva's worship.
speaker: the inscription
notes: Skeleton from memory; locator is the incipit (or a descriptive key when the incipit is not recalled) because vacana numbering differs between editions — fix against the Samagra Vacana Sāhitya in Phase D. The Jaina side is known here only through this Śaiva record.
